name: Boosted FPS (Optimized Performance)
description: A performance-focused Bedrock texture pack that disables costly fog and particles while optimizing animations, sounds, and UI for higher FPS on low-end devices.

name: FPS Optimizer | FPS Boost Official
description: A lightweight Bedrock performance pack that reduces particles, optimizes fog, animations, textures, and sounds to deliver smoother and more stable FPS while preserving Minecraft's original look.
